subject.title: [Feature Request] Auto-linkify URLs in tool output cards (Control UI & WebChat)

question: Should a safe Control UI implementation resolve this issue with native WebChat parity tracked separately, or must both renderers land together?
rationale: The browser and SwiftUI gaps are both source-proven, but they have separate owners, implementation boundaries, and proof paths; the discussion has not established that they must ship as one change.

options.title: Control UI first
options.body: Resolve the primary browser UX gap in one focused change and track native SwiftUI parity separately.

options.title: Require both renderers
options.body: Keep one cross-platform acceptance target until both Control UI and native WebChat have safe clickable URL handling.

recommendation.title: Control UI first
recommendation.body: Resolve the primary browser UX gap in one focused change and track native SwiftUI parity separately.

likelyOwner.reason: This person supplied the explicit product-side acceptance guidance and has relevant history on the Control UI tool-card surface.
